modelNotes: The corner addition retains the nominal column axes.
Bases and capitals use each column’s own lower diameter; their tops stay level by adjusting shaft length.
The architrave is outside the stated 12–30-foot range. Its height and dependent roof projection continue the model’s pattern; the text does not give this numeric extension.

The two-turn Ionic volute continues the half-eye decrement through eight quarters about one fixed centre. That continuation, the linear-radius interpolation and the fillet are modern choices, not a recovered compass construction.
